name: twelve-hour-block-hourly-spacing-intermediate-reversion
rationale: Mandatory trading-cost hypothesis, companion to the 4h variant. 2026-10-07 established an interior optimum between 8h (deficit -0.250 @500k with 1h spacing) and 24h (-2.03 @500k with 24h spacing), but the 24h point changed spacing too, so it confounds block length with drift-correction frequency. 12h block with the same 1h spacing and rsi60/bb90 isolates block length on the upper flank (lead #2 of the 2026-10-07 report).
